summary: V3-08 REPAIR not achieved: the trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35333103534 is NOT repaired by this candidate. GitHub API evidence for run 35333103534 shows the release job passed steps 1-6 (npm ci, check, privacy:check, cost:check, expo install --check, expo export android+ios, prebuild, gradlew :app:assembleRelease, APK locate+hash) and failed only at step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' (emulator). Root cause is the multi-line script: | block in .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml (lines 90-94): reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 line-splits the block and executes each line via sh -c (dash), which rejects 'set -euo pipefail' (exit 2) before APK install/golden path — the same documented root cause as finalizer runs 35293489693, 35302658175, 35315519533. The workflow on main and lab still contains the multi-line block; the trusted shell never applied the documented one-line fix. The candidate delta is ONLY package-lock.json (6 transitive dependency bumps from npm install: @types/node 22.20.3->26.6.1, undici-types 6.21.0->8.9.0, baseline-browser-mapping, electron-to-chromium, is-core-module, node-releases); src/, scripts/, __tests__/, app/ and package.json are byte-identical to the pristine accepted tree, so no product/privacy/cost/APK/runtime/E2E blocker is addressed. Trusted verification passed (exit 0: typecheck, 22 suites / 431 tests, privacy 71, cost 21 / 10 gates, expo install --check up-to-date, export, prebuild, Gradle BUILD SUCCESSFUL) and the candidate is coherent, so it is retained as WIP baseline per repair semantics. The Builder-scoped single-shell wrapper scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh (created in cycle 35310569665) exists, is bash -n clean, and is preserved; the remaining blocker is trusted-shell-owned: replace the emulator step's multi-line script: | block with 'script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh' on main and re-run the trusted finalizer. No product code change is needed. Decision: repair — a mustFix (trusted finalizer failure) remains and cannot be accepted.
